<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/locations/{locationCode}/decommissionings"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Marks the slot Decommissioned. This is a genuine domain command, not a CRUD update, which is why it is modelled as a transition resource (`decommissionings`) of the slot rather than a PATCH (REST API guideline 1.3 d). A retry with the same Idempotency-Key replays the stored 204 with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` instead of answering 409.

The transition is **one-way** in v1: there is no reactivation use case, calling it twice is a 409, and re-registering the same LocationCode afterwards is rejected as a duplicate rather than quietly resurrecting the slot. Publishes LocationSlotDecommissioned. Returns 204 with no body — there is nothing to say beyond "done".

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-generated key (a UUID per logical submit, 1-128 printable ASCII characters) that makes a retried POST safe (ADR 0019, ADR 0044). Clients MUST always send it: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR 0039), so the header is always enforced and an absent key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`. A replay with the same key, method, path and body returns the original response verbatim plus the response header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. The key is global (not per route).","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"example":"5b0f6a0e-6a41-4c63-9f33-0c8f5c1d2a77"}},{"name":"locationCode","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The slot's full seven-segment code, `SITE-AREA-ZONE-AISLE-BAY-LEVEL-POSITION`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+){6}$"},"example":"WH1-STOR-AMB-A07-03-02-B"}]}
>
